name: Aill na Mureann
text: Aill na Mureann, also written Ail na Mirenn, is a place name linked to Uisnech. Uisnech is the hill of the stone of divisions in Irish tradition. This Aill names a spot on that sacred hill. Readers should see the Uisnech entry for the site and its lore.

attributes.attribute: a place name at the hill of Uisnech
the stone of divisions site of Uisnech
